gitCommit.subject: Embed Playwright screenshots in PR comments
gitCommit.body:
Embed Playwright screenshots in PR comments

Bundles Playwright's JSON results into the report artifact, extracts each test's final screenshot into a screenshots/ folder published on GitHub Pages, and embeds them as markdown images in the PR comment so the visual result of a change is visible directly in the PR conversation.
